results.note: Asserts load_history_availability() returns all 8 (asset,venue) pairs, each with an int available_bars>0 and measured_on==date(2026,9,10). load_history_availability() (ingest/pipeline.py) parses the registry.yaml 'History availability measured YYYY-MM-DD: okx ... N daily bars; coinbase ... N daily bars.' notes via regex — a dated measured count, not a hardcoded guess.

Monkeypatches BNB/coinbase availability down to 249 (below the 250 required_bars) and asserts run_all_assets marks that venue UNCORROBORATED with an exact reason string, that no fetch call is made for that venue (assessment happens before any request, per assess_history/run_all_assets in ingest/pipeline.py), and that BNB's indicators are still Ok via the other venue — a declared limit, not a silent skip or a value computed on short data.

Pins the exact measured case from the story: asserts availability.available_bars==317, measured_on==2026-09-10, exact=True, bnb_required_bars==250, assess_history(...).status=='AVAILABLE' with surplus_bars==67, and that raising the requirement to 318 flips it to UNCORROBORATED — the registry.yaml note for bnb_rsi (line 462) literally reads 'coinbase exactly 317 daily bars', matching this regression pin.

Runs run_all_assets with synthetic fetch_bars and asserts run.indicators covers exactly the 32 technical definition keys (Counter of 8 per asset across all 4 assets), each result.status is one of OK/STALE/UNAVAILABLE/ERROR and in this run all are Ok with finite values — every asset/indicator cell is present with an explicit typed status, none silently absent.

Marked @pytest.mark.integration; calls run_all_assets() with no fetch override, so it goes through the real public entry point wiring ingest.registry.load_registry, ingest.pipeline.load_history_availability, the real ingest.fetchers.okx/coinbase fetch_btc_daily_bars functions (via _AssetClient routing BTC/ETH/SOL/BNB to their real -USDT/-USD pairs), and ingest.compute/ingest.indicators for computation against live venues — not an isolated-module unit test. This is the exact command named by the story's integration bullet.

Deterministic gate 'US-408-C6' (uv run pytest -q --no-header -o addopts=) exit code 0 as supplied, running the whole suite (no addopts override to deselect integration) against the ~32-indicator registry.
